data.cultural_impact: The name Ilango holds immense importance in the Hindu culture and is revered as an auspicious name. It is believed to bring blessings of the Sun God, Surya, who is the source of light, energy, and life. The name Ilango is also popular in Tamil literature, with the famous Tamil linguist and author, Ilango Adigal, bearing this name.
data.spiritual_significance: According to Hindu spiritual belief, the name Ilango signifies a deep connection with the Sun God, Surya. It is believed that the vibrations of the name Ilango purify the mind and instill a sense of positivity, strength, and vitality. Moreover, the name Ilango is considered to be a symbol of love, light, and knowledge, representing the Sun's radiance and enlightening power.
